Transcript
Vote #01: Final Passage – H.R. 6610, the Pharmacists Fight Back [in FEHB Plans Act]. The bill passed by a recorded vote of 40-2.
Vote #02: Final Passage – H.R. 9720, the D.C. Taxing Authority Review Act. The bill passed by a recorded vote of 23-18.
Vote #03: Final Passage – H.R. 9725, the Restoring Integrity and Efficiency to Inspector General Oversight Act of 2025. The bill passed by a recorded vote of 23-20.
Vote #04: Final Passage – H.R. 9643, the Comment Integrity and Management Act. The bill passed by a recorded vote of 24-19.
Attendance Sheet
Notice

H.R. 6610, the Pharmacists Fight
5 Back [in Federal Employee Health Benefit Plans Act]: To amend chapter 89 of title 5, United States Code, to limit the costs of pharmacy benefit managers with respect to Federal employee health benefit plans, and for other purposes.

H.R. 9720, the D.C. Taxing Authority Review Act: To require a resolution of approval by Congress of Acts of the District
of Columbia with respect to title 47 of the District of Columbia Code or which impose or increase a tax or fee, and for other purposes.

H.R. 9725, the Restoring Integrity and Efficiency to Inspector General Oversight Act of 2025: To amend title 5, United States Code, to abolish the Council of the Inspectors
General on Integrity and Efficiency, and for other purposes.

H.R. 9643, the Comment Integrity and Management Act: To amend section 206 of the E-Government Act of 2002 to improve the
integrity and management of mass comments and computer-generated
comments in the regulatory review process, and for other purposes.
H.R. 9741, To name the DC Tuition Assistance Grant program the “Eleanor Holmes Norton District of Columbia Tuition Assistance Grant Program”
